Teacher OS Pilot: Requirements for 10 November

Product requirements · Mostafa Kamal High School · Class 8 Mathematics

Context

Teacher OS is Shikho's platform for teachers: they prepare lessons, teach on the classroom panel (IFP), take attendance and enter marks. Today it runs as a demo, built to show schools what a digital classroom can do. The first pilot is at Mostafa Kamal High School, Chauddagram, Cumilla, with Class 8 Mathematics: 104 students and 5 teachers. Tablets and teacher training reach the school on 10 November 2026, and lessons start on 1 January 2027.

Why the system has to change

For the pilot, Teacher OS has to run for a real school with real data, and be set up so the next schools can be added the same way. Today some parts show dummy data and some only work for the demo:

  • Demo only: anyone can sign up with any mobile number and choose any school, class and subject.
  • Demo only: schools are added directly in the database; teachers and students are not tied to a school's own classes and sections.
  • Demo only: the admin panel can be used by Shikho staff only; a school has no admin of its own.
  • Demo only: the IFP uses one shared long token written in the website code, which never expires. The teacher's own sign-in is ignored on the IFP, so everything done there is saved under one shared account.
  • Dummy: no OTP is sent by SMS; a fixed test code is used or the code is only written to the server log.
  • Dummy: the teacher's Account page shows fixed statistics, not the teacher's own use.
  • Dummy: past attendance shows six fixed records, not the teacher's own.
  • Needs a fix: marks entry changes some typed marks without telling the teacher; the help number shows 999 instead of 16780; quiz answers show "ext" inside numbers and formulas; attendance and marks save section "A" for every student.
Scope

Eighteen tasks for teacher training on 10 November. Tasks 1 to 10 are urgent: the Account page, help number and marks entry; IFP sign-in with the teacher's own account and real-time sync with the tablet; attendance and marks by section; past attendance; quiz numbers and formulas; a pilot environment separate from the demo; and screens that fit the IFP and the tablet. Tasks 11 to 18 set up the school and access: Shikho creates the school and invites its school admin; the school admin sets up classes, sections and subjects, and adds teachers and students; teachers are invited by SMS, verify their number once with an OTP, set a password, and sign in with mobile number and password.

Task 4

IFP sign-in by QR or code with the teacher's own token

UrgentChangeBackend · Frontend
Teacher: Signs in to the IFP by QR scan or code and their own account opens, so that class work is saved under their name.
Where📺IFP · BenQ 86″, 4K📱HONOR Pad X9a · 11.5″⚙Backend
Teams⚙Backend🖥Frontend✓QA
Today
  • Short token: what a teacher gets at sign-in. The access token lasts 24 hours and is renewed with a refresh token that lasts 7 days.
  • Long token: what the IFP uses today. One token is written in the website code (src/lib/ifpAuth.ts), belongs to one shared organization account, and never expires.
  • On every IFP page the website sends the long token, not the teacher's own, and the automatic renewal is switched off. The QR or code sign-in passes the teacher's tokens to the panel, but the IFP pages ignore them.
  • A token with no end date cannot be cancelled on its own. Only changing the backend's signing key ends it, and that signs everyone out once.
  • "Generate device token" in the admin panel makes more long tokens: 365 days by default, or "Never expires".
Build
  1. After the QR scan or the typed code, the IFP uses that teacher's own short token and renews it with the refresh token.
  2. Remove the long token from the website code.
  3. Remove the "Never expires" option from "Generate device token".
  4. Change the backend's signing key once, after the new sign-in is live.
Accept when
  • Work done on the IFP is saved under the teacher who signed in.
  • A request with the old long token is refused.
  • The IFP stays signed in through the school day.

Task 8

Quiz shows numbers and formulas correctly

UrgentChangeBackend
Teacher: Generated Class 8 Mathematics quizzes show every number and formula correctly on the tablet and the IFP.
Where📱HONOR Pad X9a · 11.5″📺IFP · BenQ 86″, 4K⚙Backend
Teams⚙Backend🖥Frontend✓QA
Today
On screen
1"১,০০০ মিটার" shows as "১০ext০০ মিটার".
2"১০,০০০ মিটার" shows as "১০ext০০০ মিটার".
Cause
  • The AI returns the quiz as JSON, with formulas in LaTeX such as \text, \times, \frac.
  • In JSON, \t, \f, \n, \r and \b are control characters. When the backend reads the reply (mapQuizResponse in internal/infrastructure/llm/mapper.go), \text becomes a tab followed by "ext".
  • Lesson plan, AI help, smart book AI and smart class AI read their replies the same way.
Build
  1. Keep LaTeX backslashes intact when reading AI replies, for every AI feature.
  2. Test with numbers of 1,000 and above, fractions and multiplication signs in Bangla questions.
Accept when
  • A Class 8 algebra quiz shows every number and formula correctly on the tablet and the IFP.

Build
  1. Number → backend finds an Active account → password screen.
  2. Correct password signs in. No OTP at login.
  3. Forgot password: OTP to the same number → new password and confirm → signed in. All other sessions end.
  4. Stay signed in on the tablet for 30 days (proposed).
  5. Password at least 8 characters (proposed); stored only as a hash.
Edge cases
  • 5 wrong passwords: pause 15 minutes, offer Forgot password (proposed).
  • Deactivated teacher: "Your access has been turned off. Please contact your school admin."
  • Invited but not yet signed up: goes to Task 17 step 3.
Accept when
  • GIVENan Active teacher WHENthey enter number and password THENthey reach Home with no SMS sent.
  • GIVENa forgotten password WHENthey complete A and B THENthe old password no longer works.
